g.title: video_processor_software
g.text: Firmware sw/*.py (pyc.py inlines every module into one image, py_boot copies it from SPI flash at reset). Blue = main program, orange = interrupt handler,
green = tracking loop (section 8), purple = tracker state per target. Grey text: function (module); stage = value of the global the testbench watches.

g.title: cluster_isr
g.text: sw/video_proc.py, any time interrupts are enabled

g.title: reset
g.text: py_boot: flash image -> code / constant memory

g.title: s2
g.text: SYSCTL, INTC, GPIO, UART1, UART0, SPI, I2C, flash, WDT

g.title: s4
g.text: serial clocks, camera reset / frame gap (I2C 0 CCI),

g.title: s9
g.text: checks passed / failed, "END OF REPORT", UART drained

g.title: s6
g.text: video_start (video_setup.py) LED_RUN when no error stage 100

g.title: s7
g.text: wait idle, clear counts / event log, count the sequence

g.title: s8
g.text: for each camera tracking sequence (reg 0x56, loaded = 0x57)

g.title: t_setup
g.text: frame size from camera regs 0x30-0x33 -> every block (frame_size),
detectors (detect_setup), feature_detect, overlay boxes and texts

g.title: t_line
g.text: first stage / last stage: frame number, time

g.title: t_step
g.text: read blobs (BLOB_X / Y / N), shape check (class_ok),
track_step, move box + search window, COMMIT overlay

g.title: t_rep
g.text: frames, targets found per class, CPU time per step

g.title: i_fc
g.text: clear STATUS (W1C) and read it back
